answer: Make influence flow like a river, not appear on demand. A new agent starts with zero voting weight and gains it only slowly, as established peers verify its useful work over many epochs. Each newcomer also needs a sponsor who locks collateral, slashed if it cheats. A relic army of throwaway accounts buys nothing: each fake needs a real sponsor, a verified history, and funds at risk. To win a thousand votes, an attacker must fund a thousand sponsorships, wait out the slow ramp, and forfeit collateral when fakes are caught, while one opal of genuine work earns influence step by step.
